description: This file is a C++ source file implementing network information handling, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems. It contains classes and functions for network interface enumeration, address management, route handling, and network state monitoring within the WPEFramework Core namespace.
external_files: <POSIX-specific headers: arpa/inet.h, ifaddrs.h, net/if_arp.h, rtnetlink.h, list, net/if.h, netinet/in.h, sys/ioctl.h, sys/socket.h>

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to query and modify its state, addresses, and routes.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to their properties such as name and MAC address.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing the collection of network interfaces and their addresses, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: RoutingTable::Route
classes.description: Represents a network route with source, destination, gateway, interface, and other attributes.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Manages network routes, capable of retrieving routing information from the system.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string representation with delimiters.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information from the system, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: IPV6AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Count
methods.description: Returns the number of network adapters.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the current network adapter as a string.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the adapter's configuration.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the adapter's configuration.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Gateway
methods.description: Configures a gateway for a network.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Broadcast
methods.description: Configures broadcast address for a network.

methods.name: Network::Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Gateway
methods.description: Sets a gateway for the network.

methods.name: Network::Update
methods.description: Updates network interface attributes based on netlink messages.
